title: Existence of the normalized coefficient reduction model
statement: For every coefficient tensor record T there exists a coefficient derived-system reduction record R whose tensor subrecord is T.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 07A4, 07A6 and 0941; sequence projection and scalar-extension construction

proof.text: Apply the sequence projection derived adjunction and its limit projections to the completed coefficient ring and quotient tower. Transport the resulting adjunction through the strict-system sequence equivalence, identify finite evaluations with the actual scalar-derived pairs, and retain the prescribed tensor record T. The unit and counit projection equations, K-flat model and normalization fields are the transported equations.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing theorem; the evaluation-data module supplies only the record.
